findings.note: Konecny has missed 10 games with a lower-body injury, and his return was not confirmed. He practiced fully on Friday and Saturday, and coach Tocchet said only that he could be an option to play Sunday, though the projected lineup has him on the top line with Zegras and Dvorak.

The Flyers are 3-8-3-1, and their recent games have mostly gone under the total, including 6-0-1 to the under in their last seven home games against strong road teams. The page lists no expert or computer picks for this game.
Before his injury, Konecny had 3 assists in 5 games this season (1 on the power play), averaging 16:48 of ice time. His ESPN status still shows IR from his placement about 20 days ago.
